sections.label: Book 14
sections.name: The fire altar: the second, third and fourth layers

verses.sa: ध्रुवक्षितिर्ध्रुवयोनिर्ध्रुवाऽसि ध्रुवं योनिमा सीद साधुया। उख्यस्य केतुं प्रथमं जुषाणाऽश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: dhruvakṣitirdhruvayonirdhruvā'si dhruvaṃ yonimā sīda sādhuyā ukhyasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ juṣāṇā'śvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: With stedfast site and birthplace thou art stedfast: settle thou duly in thy stedfast birthplace, rejoicing in the Ukhya's first appearance. Here let the A$vins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

verses.sa: कुलायिनी घृतवती पुरुन्धिः स्योने सीद सदने पृथिव्याः। अभि त्वा रुद्रा वसवो गृणन्त्विमा ब्रह्म पीपिहि सौभगायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: kulāyinī ghṛtavatī purundhiḥ syone sīda sadane pṛthivyāḥ abhi tvā rudrā vasavo gṛṇantvimā brahma pīpihi saubhagāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: Nesting, intelligent, dripping with butter, in the auspicious seat of earth be seated. Let Rudras, Vasus welcome thee with praises: fill full \these prayers for our propitious fortune. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

verses.sa: स्वैर्दक्षैर्दक्षपितेह सीद देवानां सुम्ने बृहते रणाय। पितेवैधि सूनव आ सुशेवा स्वावेशा तन्वा सं विशस्वाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: svairdakṣairdakṣapiteha sīda devānāṃ sumne bṛhate raṇāya pitevaidhi sūnava ā suśevā svāveśā tanvā saṃ viśasvāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: Here, Guard of Strength, with thine own powers be seated for the Gods' happiness and great enjoyment. Even as a father to his son, be friendly: with easy en entrance enter with thy body. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus seat thee:

verses.sa: पृथिव्याः पुरीषमस्यप्सो नाम तां त्वा विश्वे अभि गृणन्तु देवाः। स्तोमपृष्ठा घृतवतीह सीद प्रजावदस्मे द्रविणाऽऽयजस्वाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyāḥ purīṣamasyapso nāma tāṃ tvā viśve abhi gṛṇantu devāḥ stomapṛṣṭhā ghṛtavatīha sīda prajāvadasme draviṇā''yajasvāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: Thou art the filling-stuff of earth called Apsas, May all the Gods celebrate thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas and butter, sit here and give us wealth with store of children. Here let the Asvins, etc.

verses.sa: अदित्यास्त्वा पृष्ठे सादयाम्यन्तरिक्षस्य धर्त्रीं विष्टम्भनीं दिशामधिपत्नीं भुवनानाम्। ऊर्मिर्द्रप्सो अपामसि विश्वकर्मा त ऋषिरश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: adityāstvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmyantarikṣasya dhartrīṃ viṣṭambhanīṃ diśāmadhipatnīṃ bhuvanānām ūrmirdrapso apāmasi viśvakarmā ta ṛṣiraśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: Upon the back of Aditi I lay thee the sky's supporter, pillar of the Quarters, Queen over creatures. Wave and drop of waters art thou; and Visvakarman is thy Rishi.

verses.sa: शुक्रश्च शुचिश्च ग्रैष्मावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे। ग्रैष्मावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: śukraśca śuciśca graiṣmāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime graiṣmāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: §Sukra and $Suchi, seasons, both, of summer—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate,.accordant, my precedence. Let all the Agnis 'twixt the earth and heaven gather together round these summer seasons, as the Gods gather in their hosts round Indra, Firm, with that Deity, Angtras-like, be seated.

verses.sa: सजूरृतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजूर्देवैः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा सजूरृतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजूर्वसुभिः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा सजूरृतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजू रुद्रैः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा सजूरृतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजूरादित्यैः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा सजूरृतुभिः सजूर्विधाभिः सजूर्विश्वैर्देवैः सजूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैरग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाश्विनाऽध्वर्यू सादयतामिह त्वा॥
verses.tr: sajūrṛtubhiḥ sajūrvidhābhiḥ sajūrdevaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhiḥ sajūrvidhābhiḥ sajūrvasubhiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhiḥ sajūrvidhābhiḥ sajū rudraiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhiḥ sajūrvidhābhiḥ sajūrādityaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā sajūrṛtubhiḥ sajūrvidhābhiḥ sajūrviśvairdevaiḥ sajūrdevairvayonādhairagnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāśvinā'dhvaryū sādayatāmiha tvā
verses.en: Associate with the Seasons, with the Modes with the Gods, with the health-establishing Gods—may the A^vins the Adhvaryus settle thee here for Agni Vai$ v&nara. Associate.......with the Vasus, etc. Associate with the tbe Rudras, etc. Associate... with the Adityas, etc. Associate with the Visvedevas, etc.

verses.sa: प्राणं मे पाह्यपानं मे पाहि व्यानं मे पाहि चक्षुर्म उर्व्या वि भाहि श्रोत्रं मे श्लोकय। अपः पिन्वौषधीर्जिन्व द्विपादव चतुष्पात् पाहि दिवो वृष्टिमेरय॥
verses.tr: prāṇaṃ me pāhyapānaṃ me pāhi vyānaṃ me pāhi cakṣurma urvyā vi bhāhi śrotraṃ me ślokaya apaḥ pinvauṣadhīrjinva dvipādava catuṣpāt pāhi divo vṛṣṭimeraya
verses.en: Guard thou my breath. Guard my out-breathing. Guard my through-breathing. Illume mine eye with far-reaching«> ing vision. Give power of hearing to mine ear. Pour forth waters. Quicken plants. Protect bipeds. Protect quadrupeds. Send rain from heaven.

verses.sa: मूर्धा वयः प्रजापतिश्छन्दः क्षत्रं वयो मयन्दं छन्दो विष्टम्भो वयोऽधिपतिश्छन्दो विश्वकर्मा वयः परमेष्ठी छन्दो बस्तो वयो विवलं छन्दो वृष्णिर्वयो विशालं छन्दः पुरुषो वयस्तन्द्रं छन्दो व्याघ्रो वयोऽनाधृष्टं छन्दः सिंहो वयश्छदिश्छन्दः पष्ठवाड्वयो बृहती छन्द उक्षा वयः ककुप् छन्द ऋषभो वयः सतोबृहती छन्दः॥
verses.tr: mūrdhā vayaḥ prajāpatiśchandaḥ kṣatraṃ vayo mayandaṃ chando viṣṭambho vayo'dhipatiśchando viśvakarmā vayaḥ parameṣṭhī chando basto vayo vivalaṃ chando vṛṣṇirvayo viśālaṃ chandaḥ puruṣo vayastandraṃ chando vyāghro vayo'nādhṛṣṭaṃ chandaḥ siṃho vayaśchadiśchandaḥ paṣṭhavāḍvayo bṛhatī chanda ukṣā vayaḥ kakup chanda ṛṣabho vayaḥ satobṛhatī chandaḥ
verses.en: The head is vital vigour. Prajapati became the metre. Royalty is vital vigour, health-giving metre. The Supporter is vital vigour, the Sovran Lord the metre. Visvakarman is vital vigour, Parameshthin the metre. The he-goat is vital vigour, excellent the metre. The bull is vital! vigour, extensive the metre. Man is vital vigour, languid the metre. The tiger is vital vigour, invincible the metre. The lion is vital vigour, covering the metre. The four-year bull is vital vigour, Brihatt the metre. The ox is vital vigour, Kakup the metre. The steer is vital vigour, Satobphati the metre.

verses.sa: अनड्वान्वयः पङ्क्तिश्छन्दो धेनुर्वयो जगती छन्दत्र्यविर्वयस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो दित्यवाड्वयो विराट् छन्दः पञ्चाविर्वयो गायत्री छन्द स्त्रिवत्सो वय उष्णिक् छन्दऽ स्तुर्यवाड्वयोऽनुष्टुप् छन्दो लोकं ता इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: anaḍvānvayaḥ paṅktiśchando dhenurvayo jagatī chandatryavirvayastriṣṭup chando dityavāḍvayo virāṭ chandaḥ pañcāvirvayo gāyatrī chanda strivatso vaya uṣṇik chanda' sturyavāḍvayo'nuṣṭup chando lokaṃ tā indram
verses.en: The bullock is vital vigour, Pankti the metre. The milch-cow is vital vigour, Jagatt the metre. The eighteen-month calf is vital vigour, Trishtup the metre. The two year old steer is vital vigour, Viraj the metre. The thirty-month old ewe is vital vigour, Gayatri the metre. The three year old steer is vital vigour, Ushnih the metre. The four year old ox is vital vigour, 'Anushtup the metre. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, eta All sacred songs, etc. are three texts repeated from XII. $XXL—54-*-56!. See also XIII.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी अव्यथमानामिष्टकां दृंहतं युवम्। पृष्ठेन द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं च वि बाधसे॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī avyathamānāmiṣṭakāṃ dṛṃhataṃ yuvam pṛṣṭhena dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ ca vi bādhase
verses.en: Indra and Agni, in its place securely set the unshaking. brick. Thou with thy back sunderest heaven and the broad earth and firmament.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्वन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठे व्यचस्वतीं प्रथस्वतीमन्तरिक्षं यच्छान्तरिक्षं दृंहान्तरिक्षं मा हिंसीः। विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानायोदानाय प्रतिष्ठायै चरित्राय। वायुष्ट्वाऽभि पातु मह्या स्वस्त्या छर्दिषा शन्तमेन तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīmantarikṣaṃ yacchāntarikṣaṃ dṛṃhāntarikṣaṃ mā hiṃsīḥ viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya vāyuṣṭvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: On the air's back let Visvakarman set thee, thee the capacious, thee the far-extended. Control the air, fix firm the air, do thou the air no injury. For all breath, out breath, through-breath, upward breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Tllyu keep thee safe with great well-being, with securest shelter. In the manner of Angiras, with that Deity. lie steady.

verses.sa: राज्ञ्यसि प्राची दिग्विराडसि दक्षिणा दिक् सम्राडसि प्रतीची दिक् स्वराडस्युदीची दिगधिपत्न्यसि बृहती दिक्॥
verses.tr: rājñyasi prācī digvirāḍasi dakṣiṇā dik samrāḍasi pratīcī dik svarāḍasyudīcī digadhipatnyasi bṛhatī dik
verses.en: Queen art thou. Quarter of the East. Wide ruler, Quarter of the South. West Quarter, thou art Sovran. Thou Queen Paramount art thou, the Lofty Point.

verses.sa: विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयत्वन्तरिक्षस्य पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम्। विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानाय विश्वं ज्योतिर्यच्छ। वायुष्टेऽधिपतिस्तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatvantarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha vāyuṣṭe'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: On the air's back may Yisvakarman set thee luminous. Control all light for all breath, for out-breath, up-breath, through. -breath. Thy Lord is Vayu, with that Deity, Angiras-like, lie firm.

verses.sa: नभश्च नभस्यश्च वार्षिकावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे। वार्षिकावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: nabhaśca nabhasyaśca vārṣikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime vārṣikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: Two Rainy Seasons, Nabhas and Nabhasya—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

verses.sa: इषश्चोर्जश्च शारदावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे शारदावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: iṣaścorjaśca śāradāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime śāradāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: Isha and Crja, two Autumnal Season—thou art the tbe innermost cement of Agni, etc.

verses.sa: आयुर्मे पाहि प्राणं मे पाह्यपानं मे पाहि व्यानं मे पाहि चक्षुर्मे पाहि श्रोत्रं मे पाहि वाचं मे पिन्व मनो मे जिन्वात्मानं मे पाहि ज्योतिर्मे यच्छ॥
verses.tr: āyurme pāhi prāṇaṃ me pāhyapānaṃ me pāhi vyānaṃ me pāhi cakṣurme pāhi śrotraṃ me pāhi vācaṃ me pinva mano me jinvātmānaṃ me pāhi jyotirme yaccha
verses.en: Preserve my life. Preserve my breath. Guard mine outbreath. Preserve mine eyes. Preserve mine ears. Strengthen my voice. Quicken my mind. Preserve my self. Vouchsafe me light.

verses.sa: मा छन्दः प्रमा छन्दः प्रतिमा छन्दो अस्रीवयश्छन्दः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उष्णिक् छन्दो बृहती छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप् छन्दो विराट् छन्दो गायत्री छन्द स्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो जगती छन्दः॥
verses.tr: mā chandaḥ pramā chandaḥ pratimā chando asrīvayaśchandaḥ paṅktiśchanda uṣṇik chando bṛhatī chando 'nuṣṭup chando virāṭ chando gāyatrī chanda striṣṭup chando jagatī chandaḥ
verses.en: M& metre. Pram metre. PratimA metre. Asrivayas metre. Pankti metre. Ushnih metre. Brihati! metre. Anushtup metre. Viraj metre. G&yatrt metre. Trishtup metre. Jagati! metre.

verses.sa: पृथिवी छन्दो ऽन्तरिक्षं छन्दो द्यौश्छन्दः समाश्छन्दो नक्षत्राणि छन्दो वाक् छन्दो मनश्छन्दः कृषिश्छन्दो हिरण्यं छन्दो गौश्छन्दो ऽजाश्छन्दो ऽश्वश्छन्दः॥
verses.tr: pṛthivī chando 'ntarikṣaṃ chando dyauśchandaḥ samāśchando nakṣatrāṇi chando vāk chando manaśchandaḥ kṛṣiśchando hiraṇyaṃ chando gauśchando 'jāśchando 'śvaśchandaḥ
verses.en: Earth metre. Sky metre. Heaven metre. Years metre. Nakshatras metre. V&k metre. Mind metre. Husbandry metre. Gold metre. Cow metre. She-goat metre. Horse metre.

verses.sa: अग्निर्देवता वातो देवता सूर्यो देवता चन्द्रमा देवता वसवो देवता रुद्रा देवता ऽऽदित्या देवता मरुतो देवता विश्वे देवा देवता बृहस्पतिर्देवतेन्द्रो देवता वरुणो देवता॥
verses.tr: agnirdevatā vāto devatā sūryo devatā candramā devatā vasavo devatā rudrā devatā ''dityā devatā maruto devatā viśve devā devatā bṛhaspatirdevatendro devatā varuṇo devatā
verses.en: The Deity Agni. The Deity Vita. The Deity Sdrya. The Deity Moon. The Deity VasuS. The Deity Rudras. The Deity Adityas. The Deity Maruts. The Deity Visvedevas, The Deity Brihaspati. The Deity Indra. The Deity Varuna.

verses.sa: मूर्धाऽसि राड् ध्रुवाऽसि धरुणा धर्त्र्यसि धरणी। आयुषे त्वा वर्चसे त्वा कृष्यै त्वा क्षेमाय त्वा॥
verses.tr: mūrdhā'si rāḍ dhruvā'si dharuṇā dhartryasi dharaṇī āyuṣe tvā varcase tvā kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā
verses.en: Chief art thou, bright, supporting, firm, thou art the great sustainer, Earth. Thee for life, thee for lustre, thee for tillage, thee for peace and rest.

verses.sa: यन्त्री राड् यन्त्र्यसि यमनी ध्रुवाऽसि धरित्री। इषे त्वोर्जे त्वा रय्यै त्वा पोषाय त्वा लोकं ता इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: yantrī rāḍ yantryasi yamanī dhruvā'si dharitrī iṣe tvorje tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā lokaṃ tā indram
verses.en: Controller, brilliant art thou, managing controller, firm sustainer. Per For strength, for energy thee, for riches thee, for prosperity thee. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. (as in 10).

verses.sa: आशुस्त्रिवृद्भान्तः पञ्चदशो व्योमा सप्तदशो धरुण एकविंशः प्रतूर्तिरष्टादशस्तपो नवदशो ऽभीवर्त्तः सविंशो वर्चो द्वाविंशः सम्भरणस्त्रयोविंशो योनिश्चतुर्विंशो गर्भाः पञ्चविंश ओजस्त्रिणवः क्रतुरेकत्रिंशः प्रतिष्ठा त्रयस्त्रिंशो ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं चतुस्त्रिंशो नाकः षट्त्रिंशो विवर्तोऽष्टाचत्वारिंशो धर्त्रं चतुष्टोमः॥
verses.tr: āśustrivṛdbhāntaḥ pañcadaśo vyomā saptadaśo dharuṇa ekaviṃśaḥ pratūrtiraṣṭādaśastapo navadaśo 'bhīvarttaḥ saviṃśo varco dvāviṃśaḥ sambharaṇastrayoviṃśo yoniścaturviṃśo garbhāḥ pañcaviṃśa ojastriṇavaḥ kraturekatriṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhā trayastriṃśo bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ catustriṃśo nākaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśo vivarto'ṣṭācatvāriṃśo dhartraṃ catuṣṭomaḥ
verses.en: The Swift, the triple praise-song. The Shining, the Pafichadasa hymn. Heaven, the Saptadasa. The Supporter-, the £Ekavimfa. Speed, the Ash^Masa. Ardour, the Navada$a. Triumphant Onset, Ashvinis, Vigour, Dv^virpsa. Maintenance, Trayoviinga. Womb, Chaturviipsa.' Embryos, Pafiohavimsa, Energy, the Trinava. Intention, the Ekatrixpsa. The Basis, the Trayastrimsa. The Bright One's Station, the ChatustrirpBa. The Vault of Heaven, the Shattriipfa. The Revolving One, the Asht^ohatvariqisa. The Support, the Fuur-divisioned praise-song.

verses.sa: अग्नेर्भागोऽसि दीक्षाया आधिपत्यं ब्रह्म स्पृतं त्रिवृत्स्तोम इन्द्रस्य भागोऽसि विष्णोराधिपत्यं क्षत्रं स्पृतं पञ्चदशः स्तोमो नृचक्षसां भागोऽसि धातुराधिपत्यं जनित्रं स्पृतं सप्तदश स्तोमो मित्रस्य भागोऽसि वरुणस्याधिपत्यं दिवो वृष्टिर्वात स्पृत एकविंश स्तोमः॥
verses.tr: agnerbhāgo'si dīkṣāyā ādhipatyaṃ brahma spṛtaṃ trivṛtstoma indrasya bhāgo'si viṣṇorādhipatyaṃ kṣatraṃ spṛtaṃ pañcadaśaḥ stomo nṛcakṣasāṃ bhāgo'si dhāturādhipatyaṃ janitraṃ spṛtaṃ saptadaśa stomo mitrasya bhāgo'si varuṇasyādhipatyaṃ divo vṛṣṭirvāta spṛta ekaviṃśa stomaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the portion of Agni, chief of control of oration. The Priesthood is saved; the Trivrit Stoma. Thou art the portion of Indra, the sovranty of Vishnu, The Nobility is saved; the Pafichadasa Stoma. Then art the share of the Man-beholder; the supremacy of the Creator; the birthplace is saved; the Saptadaaa Stoma. Thou art the share of Mitra, the sovranty of Varuna. Rain of heaven and wind are saved; the £kaviinfa Stoma.

verses.sa: वसूनां भागोऽसि रुद्राणामाधिपत्यं चतुष्पात् स्पृतं चतुर्विंश स्तोम आदित्यानां भागोऽसि मरुतामाधिपत्यं गर्भा स्पृताः पञ्चविंश स्तोमो ऽदित्यै भागोऽसि पूष्ण आधिपत्यमोज स्पृतं त्रिणव स्तोमो देवस्य सवितुर्भागोऽसि बृहस्पतेराधिपत्यं समीचीर्दिश स्पृताश्चतुष्टोम स्तोमः॥
verses.tr: vasūnāṃ bhāgo'si rudrāṇāmādhipatyaṃ catuṣpāt spṛtaṃ caturviṃśa stoma ādityānāṃ bhāgo'si marutāmādhipatyaṃ garbhā spṛtāḥ pañcaviṃśa stomo 'dityai bhāgo'si pūṣṇa ādhipatyamoja spṛtaṃ triṇava stomo devasya saviturbhāgo'si bṛhaspaterādhipatyaṃ samīcīrdiśa spṛtāścatuṣṭoma stomaḥ
verses.en: Thou act art the share of the Vasus, the sovranty of the Rudras. Quadrupeds are saved; the Cbatnrvimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Adityas; the sovranty of the Maruts. The £Embryos are saved; the Panohavimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of Aditi; the sovranty of Pikhan. Strength is saved; the Trinava Stoma. Thou art the share of God Savitar; the sovranty of Bfihaspati. The universal Quarters are saved; the Chatusht-ma Stoma

verses.sa: यवानां भागोऽस्ययवानामाधिपत्यं प्रजा स्पृताश्चतुश्चत्वारिंश स्तोम ऋभूणां भागोऽसि विश्वेषां देवानामाधिपत्यं भूतं स्पृतं त्रयस्त्रिंश स्तोमः॥
verses.tr: yavānāṃ bhāgo'syayavānāmādhipatyaṃ prajā spṛtāścatuścatvāriṃśa stoma ṛbhūṇāṃ bhāgo'si viśveṣāṃ devānāmādhipatyaṃ bhūtaṃ spṛtaṃ trayastriṃśa stomaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the share of the Yavas; the sovranty of the Anavas. Creatures are saved; the Chatuschatv^rimsa Stoma. Thou art the share of the Ribhus; the sovranty of the Visvedevas. The Being is saved; the Trayastriqasa Stoma.

verses.sa: सहश्च सहस्यश्च हैमन्तिकावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे। हैमन्तिकावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: sahaśca sahasyaśca haimantikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime haimantikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: Sahas, Sahasya, the two Winter Seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

verses.sa: एकयास्तुवत प्रजा अधीयन्त प्रजापतिरधिपतिरासीत् तिसृभिरस्तुवत ब्रह्मासृज्यत ब्रह्मणस्पतिरधिपतिरासीत् पञ्चभिरस्तुवत भूतान्यसृज्यन्त भूतानां पतिरधिपतिरासीत् सप्तभिरस्तुवत सप्त ऋषयोऽसृज्यन्त धाताऽधिपतिरासीत्॥
verses.tr: ekayāstuvata prajā adhīyanta prajāpatiradhipatirāsīt tisṛbhirastuvata brahmāsṛjyata brahmaṇaspatiradhipatirāsīt pañcabhirastuvata bhūtānyasṛjyanta bhūtānāṃ patiradhipatirāsīt saptabhirastuvata sapta ṛṣayo'sṛjyanta dhātā'dhipatirāsīt
verses.en: With one they praised; creatures were produced. PrajUpati was over-lord. With three they praised; the Priesthood was created. Brihaspati was over-lord.' With five they praised; beings were created. The Lord of Beings was over-lord. With sevdn they praised; the Seven Rkhis were created. Dh&tar was over-lord.

verses.sa: नवभिरस्तुवत पितरोऽसृज्यन्तादितिरधिपत्न्यासीदेकादशभिरस्तुवत ऋतवोऽसृज्यन्तार्तवा अधिपतय आसँस्त्रयोदशभिरस्तुवत मासा असृज्यन्त संवत्सरोऽधिपतिरासीत् पञ्चदशभिरस्तुवत क्षत्रमसृज्यतेन्द्रोऽधिपतिरासीत् सप्तदशभिरस्तुवत ग्राम्याः पशवोऽसृज्यन्त बृहस्पतिरधिपतिरासीत्॥
verses.tr: navabhirastuvata pitaro'sṛjyantāditiradhipatnyāsīdekādaśabhirastuvata ṛtavo'sṛjyantārtavā adhipataya āsaṃstrayodaśabhirastuvata māsā asṛjyanta saṃvatsaro'dhipatirāsīt pañcadaśabhirastuvata kṣatramasṛjyatendro'dhipatirāsīt saptadaśabhirastuvata grāmyāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta bṛhaspatiradhipatirāsīt
verses.en: With nine they praised; the Fathers were created. Aditi was Sovran Lady. With eleven they praised; the Seasons were created. The Season- Lords were over-lords. With thirteen they praised-, the Months ware created. The Year was over-lord. With fifteen they praised; the Nobility was created. Indra was overlord. With seventeen they praised; dootestiaauinials animals were created. Brihaspati was over-lord.

verses.sa: नवदशभिरस्तुवत शूद्रार्यावसृज्येतामहोरात्रे अधिपत्नी आस्तामेकविंशत्यास्तुवतैकशपाः पशवोऽसृज्यन्त वरुणोऽधिपतिरासीत् त्रयोविंशत्यास्तुवत क्षुद्राः पशवोऽसृज्यन्त पूषाऽधिपतिरासीत् पञ्चविंशत्यास्तुवतारण्याः पशवोऽसृज्यन्त वायुरधिपतिरासीत् सप्तविंशत्याऽस्तुवत द्यावापृथिवी व्यैतां वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या अनुव्यायँस्त एवाधिपतय आसन्॥
verses.tr: navadaśabhirastuvata śūdrāryāvasṛjyetāmahorātre adhipatnī āstāmekaviṃśatyāstuvataikaśapāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta varuṇo'dhipatirāsīt trayoviṃśatyāstuvata kṣudrāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta pūṣā'dhipatirāsīt pañcaviṃśatyāstuvatāraṇyāḥ paśavo'sṛjyanta vāyuradhipatirāsīt saptaviṃśatyā'stuvata dyāvāpṛthivī vyaitāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityā anuvyāyaṃsta evādhipataya āsan
verses.en: With nineteen they praised; $Adra and Arya were created. Day and Night were Sovran Ladies With twenty-one they praised; solid-hoofed animals were created. Varuna was over-lord. With twenty-three they praised; small animals were created. Pushan was over-lord. With twenty-five they praised; forest animals were created. Viyu was over-lord. With twenty-seven they praised; earth and heaven came apart. Vasus, Rudras, Adityas followed separately, so they were over-lords.

verses.sa: नवविंशत्याऽस्तुवत वनस्पतयोऽसृज्यन्त सोमोऽधिपतिरासीदेकत्रिंशताऽस्तुवत प्रजा असृज्यन्त यवाश्चायवाश्चाधिपतय आसँत्रयस्त्रिंशताऽस्तुवत भूतान्यशाम्यन् प्रजापतिः परमेष्ठ्यधिपतिरासील्लोकं ता इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: navaviṃśatyā'stuvata vanaspatayo'sṛjyanta somo'dhipatirāsīdekatriṃśatā'stuvata prajā asṛjyanta yavāścāyavāścādhipataya āsaṃtrayastriṃśatā'stuvata bhūtānyaśāmyan prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhyadhipatirāsīllokaṃ tā indram
verses.en: With twenty-nine they praised; Trees were created. Soma was over-lord. With thirty-one they praised; creatures were created. The Yavas and the Ayava were over-lords. With thirty-three they praised; living beings were happy. Prajftpati,. the Supreme in Place, was over-lord. Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred songs, etc. Repeated form Xil.,14—AU
